type: Post-hoc descriptive strata and score drivers, not a causal ablation
cold_start_rule: fewer than 32 past rows in the same stream/case/event
near_constant_rule: dominant residual feature has past-window population std <= 1e-8 in shared feature units
argmax_ties: First feature in the fixed schema order
main_evaluation: Full test remains primary; warm-only metrics are never substituted
